/* CULTURA FULL EDITORIAL STYLES */

:root {
  --cul-primary: #1C2730;
  --cul-accent-wine: #7A2832;
  --cul-accent-wine-light: #FDF2F4;
  --cul-accent-amber: #C48F09;
  --cul-accent-amber-light: #FEF9ED;
  --cul-forest: #244C3F;
  --cul-body: #334155;
  --cul-card-bg: #FFFFFF;
  --cul-card-border: #E8E5DF;
  --cul-page-bg: #F9F7F2;
  --cul-font-serif: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --cul-font-sans: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
}

/* Base resets & layout */
.cultura-editorial-wrap {
  font-family: var(--cul-font-sans);
  color: var(--cul-body);
  background-color: var(--cul-page-bg);
  line-height: 1.65;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.cultura-content-container {
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Hero Section */
.cul-fullwidth-hero {
  position: relative !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-height: 560px !important;
  max-height: 680px !important;
  height: 68vh !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background-image: url('https://www.lastrasdecuellar.net/wp-content/uploads/romeria-2018-lastras-de-cuellar.jpg') !important;
  background-size: cover !important;
  background-position: center 36% !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
  background-color: #2D1A1E !important;
}

.cul-hero-vignette {
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(15, 20, 26, 0.06) 0%, rgba(15, 20, 26, 0.22) 75%, rgba(15, 20, 26, 0.46) 100%) !important;
  z-index: 1 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

.cul-hero-bottom-fade {
  position: absolute !important;
  bottom: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 120px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(249, 247, 242, 0) 0%, rgba(249, 247, 242, 0.75) 60%, #F9F7F2 100%) !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

.cul-hero-content-wrapper {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 1200px !important;
  padding: 4rem 1.5rem 5.5rem 1.5rem !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

.cul-hero-glass-card {
  background: rgba(24, 16, 20, 0.20) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(2px) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(2px) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
  border-top: 2px solid rgba(220, 168, 56, 0.65) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  padding: 2.2rem 2.8rem !important;
  max-width: 860px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

.cul-badge-pill {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  background: rgba(196, 143, 9, 0.35) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.7) !important;
  border-radius: 9999px !important;
  padding: 6px 18px !important;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.25) !important;
}

.cul-badge-dot {
  width: 8px !important;
  height: 8px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
